scenario: BackendsCheck reports a missing system index (DSBLE0007) on the userroot backend
notes: Matches Red Hat KCS 7132895's documented BackendsCheck/DSBLE0007 missing-system-index finding. The rule's primary recommended action is the scoped `db2index.pl -t entryrdn` (CAUTION); the bare/no-argument form is only ever mentioned as an explicit HIGH_RISK warning never to run, per 389-ds-base GitHub issue #1914 (breaks replication via RUV/tombstone side effects).
